title: Proton pump inhibitor and histamine-2 receptor antagonist use and iron deficiency
authors: Lam JR, Schneider JL, Quesenberry CP, Corley DA
population: Community-based case-control study: 77,046 patients with new iron deficiency and 389,314 controls, excluding patients with pre-existing risk factors for iron deficiency
funder: Not read: the publisher page refused access and Crossref lists no funder.
result: A 2-year or longer supply of PPIs was received by 2343 cases (3.0%) and 3354 controls (0.9%): adjusted OR 2.49 (95% CI 2.35 to 2.64); H2-receptor antagonists OR 1.58 (1.46 to 1.71). Associations were stronger at more than 1.5 pills a day than at less than 0.75 (interaction P = .004), were strongest with more than 1.5 pills a day for at least 10 years (OR 4.27, 2.53 to 7.21), and decreased after discontinuation (P for trend < .001).
